prompt_text:
Task: Managed Metrics Monitoring

Write code that compares metric values for two resources or dimension filters over the same window using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Datadog:
  Service: Datadog Metrics API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: submit_metrics, query_timeseries_points
  Setup hints: DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/metrics/custom_metrics/, https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/metrics/

Option 2 — Azure Monitor Metrics:
  Service: Azure Monitor Metrics
  SDK: azure-monitor-query
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: query_resource, list_metric_namespaces, list_metric_definitions
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-platform-metrics, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/overview/azure/monitor-querymetrics-readme

Option 3 — Amazon CloudWatch Metrics:
  Service: Amazon CloudWatch Metrics
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: get_metric_data, get_metric_statistics, list_metrics
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_GetMetricData.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_ListMetrics.html

Option 4 — Alibaba CloudMonitor:
  Service: CloudMonitor
  SDK: alibabacloud_cms20190101 / Tea
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: DescribeMetricList, DescribeCustomMetricList
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET, ALIBABA_CLOUD_REGION_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2513241.html, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2513233.html

Option 5 — IBM Cloud Monitoring:
  Service: IBM Cloud Monitoring
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: POST /data, metric filters, aggregation expressions
  Setup hints: IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY, IBM_MONITORING_INSTANCE_ID, IBM_MONITORING_ENDPOINT
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/products/cloud-monitoring

Option 6 — Google Cloud Monitoring:
  Service: Cloud Monitoring
  SDK: google-cloud-monitoring
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: list_time_series, list_metric_descriptors
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.timeSeries/list, https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.metricDescriptors/list

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import boto3


def compare_cloudwatch_metrics(
    namespace: str,
    metric_name: str,
    resource_a_dimensions: List[Dict[str, str]],
    resource_b_dimensions: List[Dict[str, str]],
    start_time: datetime,
    end_time: datetime,
    period: int = 300,
    stat: str = "Average",
    region_name: Optional[str] = None,
    unit: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, object]:
    if start_time.tzinfo is None:
        start_time = start_time.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    if end_time.tzinfo is None:
        end_time = end_time.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    client = boto3.client("cloudwatch", region_name=region_name or os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"))

    def _metric_query(query_id: str, dimensions: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> Dict[str, object]:
        metric = {
            "Namespace": namespace,
            "MetricName": metric_name,
            "Dimensions": dimensions,
        }
        if unit:
            metric["Unit"] = unit

        return {
            "Id": query_id,
            "ReturnData": True,
            "MetricStat": {
                "Metric": metric,
                "Period": period,
                "Stat": stat,
            },
        }

    response = client.get_metric_data(
        MetricDataQueries=[
            _metric_query("a", resource_a_dimensions),
            _metric_query("b", resource_b_dimensions),
        ],
        StartTime=start_time,
        EndTime=end_time,
        ScanBy="TimestampAscending",
    )

    result_map = {r["Id"]: r for r in response.get("MetricDataResults", [])}

    series_a = result_map.get("a", {})
    series_b = result_map.get("b", {})

    points_a = list(zip(series_a.get("Timestamps", []), series_a.get("Values", [])))
    points_b = list(zip(series_b.get("Timestamps", []), series_b.get("Values", [])))

    aligned_a = {ts: val for ts, val in points_a}
    aligned_b = {ts: val for ts, val in points_b}
    common_timestamps = sorted(set(aligned_a.keys()) & set(aligned_b.keys()))

    diffs = []
    ratios = []
    aligned_points = []

    for ts in common_timestamps:
        a_val = aligned_a[ts]
        b_val = aligned_b[ts]
        diff = a_val - b_val
        ratio = (a_val / b_val) if b_val not in (0, 0.0) else None
        diffs.append(diff)
        if ratio is not None:
            ratios.append(ratio)
        aligned_points.append(
            {
                "timestamp": ts.isoformat(),
                "resource_a": a_val,
                "resource_b": b_val,
                "difference": diff,
                "ratio_a_to_b": ratio,
            }
        )

    def _summary(values: List[float]) -> Optional[Dict[str, float]]:
        if not values:
            return None
        return {
            "min": min(values),
            "max": max(values),
            "avg": sum(values) / len(values),
            "sum": sum(values),
            "count": float(len(values)),
        }

    return {
        "provider": "amazon_cloudwatch",
        "region": client.meta.region_name,
        "namespace": namespace,
        "metric_name": metric_name,
        "stat": stat,
        "period": period,
        "start_time": start_time.isoformat(),
        "end_time": end_time.isoformat(),
        "resource_a_dimensions": resource_a_dimensions,
        "resource_b_dimensions": resource_b_dimensions,
        "resource_a_status_code": series_a.get("StatusCode"),
        "resource_b_status_code": series_b.get("StatusCode"),
        "resource_a_label": series_a.get("Label"),
        "resource_b_label": series_b.get("Label"),
        "resource_a_summary": _summary(series_a.get("Values", [])),
        "resource_b_summary": _summary(series_b.get("Values", [])),
        "difference_summary": _summary(diffs),
        "ratio_a_to_b_summary": _summary(ratios),
        "aligned_points": aligned_points,
        "messages": {
            "resource_a": series_a.get("Messages", []),
            "resource_b": series_b.get("Messages", []),
        },
    }
